Proposition
[Analytic orbifolds are good] 1. 13.3.2\group surfaces Source: thurston:page-0328

If $G$ is an analytic group of diffeomorphisms of a manifold $X$, every $(G,X)$-orbifold is good and admits a developing map from its universal cover.
Proof

\sketch Analytic continuation of local lifts along paths produces a developing map; analyticity makes continuation unique after isotropy identifications. The resulting continuation cover is a manifold covering orbifold.

□
